example.title: Long Beach International Gateway (I-710 over the Back Channel)

brief: Coast Hwy over the Miami's mouth into the South Sea (West Coast). Modelled on the Long Beach International Gateway: a cable-stayed bridge with a 305 m main span between two 157 m white concrete towers that go from octagonal at the base to diamond-shaped at the top, fans of white stays to twin deck edges, 62 m clearance, long precast approaches, a pedestrian and bicycle path. Here: a 260 m main span, the towers on the river's banks, approaches over the basin and the beach. Foundations: large-diameter drilled shafts 30 m below the modelled bed.
